description: What money can buy, in rough estimates for one person, in today's euros: a published average, a calculation from published figures (see calc), months of living costs somewhere, with housing (monthsAt, monthsHome), or a price for each country of the prices (prices). Estimates, not live data, not advice.

conversion.note: USD figures converted at the rate used in cost-of-living.json.

buy.name: An e-bike
buy.source: RAI Vereniging and BOVAG (NielsenIQ): average price of an e-bike sold in the Netherlands in 2025, published February 2026.

buy.name: A driving licence
buy.source: CBR: average total cost of a Dutch B licence in 2025 (41 lessons, theory and practical exams), published March 2026.

buy.name: A set of home solar panels
buy.source: Milieu Centraal: indicative price of 10 solar panels of 435 Wp installed in the Netherlands (panels, inverter and fitting, 0% VAT).

buy.name: A hybrid heat pump
buy.source: Milieu Centraal: 4 kW hybrid heat pump with installation and VAT, before subsidy (about EUR 2,125 back).

buy.name: Three months living in Japan
buy.source: 3 months of Japan's living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A year travelling Southeast Asia
buy.source: 12 months at the average living cost with rent of Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: Six months living in Portugal
buy.source: 6 months of Portugal's living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A new kitchen
buy.source: Homedeal: average price of a standard kitchen with appliances and installation in the Netherlands (range EUR 7,000 to 25,000).

buy.name: Paying off an average student debt
buy.source: DUO: average student debt in the Netherlands at the start of 2025 (median EUR 10,300).

buy.name: A wedding

NL.note: Sum of the minimum or average rates of the wedding suppliers listed on ThePerfectWedding.nl, without the honeymoon; not a survey of couples.

ES.source: Bodas.net, Informe de la Industria Nupcial 2026
ES.note: Weddings of 2025, without the honeymoon or rings.

DE.note: Average cost of a German wedding in 2025.

PT.note: Estimated cost of a wedding for 100 guests, 2025.

buy.source: Average cost of a wedding in each country, from surveys of couples (see each price).

buy.name: A used car

NL.note: Average asking price of a used car in 2025 (AutoScout24 annual analysis 2025, 12 December 2025).

ES.note: Average asking price of a used car, average of 2025 (EUR 17,758).

DE.note: Average price private buyers paid for a used car in 2025.

FR.note: Average asking price of a used car, Q3 2025.

IT.note: Average asking price of a used car, annual analysis 2025.

PT.note: Average asking price of professional sellers' used cars, December 2025 (Automonitor/Lusa, 19 January 2026).

buy.source: Average price of a used car in each country (see each price).

buy.name: A master's year in the Netherlands
buy.source: Statutory tuition fee 2025-2026 of EUR 2,601 (Rijksoverheid) plus 12 months of Dutch living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A used electric car
buy.source: AutoScout24: average asking price of a used electric car in the Netherlands, average of 2025 (published 26 January 2026).

buy.name: A 10% deposit on a Dutch home
buy.source: 10% of the average price of an existing home in the Netherlands in 2025, EUR 480,000 (CBS, published February 2026).

buy.name: A new car

NL.note: Average price of a new car sold in the first half of 2025 (NL Times and Autoweek, August 2025); no full-year 2025 figure found.

ES.note: Average price of new cars offered by official dealers in 2025, with discounts, before subsidies.

DE.note: Average price private buyers paid for a new car in 2025.

FR.note: Average list price of new cars sold in 2025, before discounts, subsidies and penalties.

IT.note: Average value per new car registered in 2025, net of discounts (list price EUR 35,362); ANIASA, 30 June 2026.

buy.source: Average price of a new car in each country (see each price).

buy.name: Taking over a small business
buy.source: Your own 35% of a EUR 200,000 price: small Dutch businesses often sell for about 4 times yearly profit (here EUR 50,000), and banks usually lend 60-70% (Brookz, Inter Actus).

buy.name: An 80 m² flat in upscale Lima, Peru
buy.source: BCRP (Banco Central de Reserva del Perú): average asking price of flats in the districts its housing-price index covers, well-off areas such as Miraflores, San Isidro and Santiago de Surco, not all of Lima: USD 1,868 per m² in Q4 2025, published March 2026.

buy.name: An 80 m² flat in Portugal
buy.source: INE Portugal: median bank valuation of flats in 2025, EUR 2,239 per m².

buy.name: An average Dutch home, fully paid
buy.source: CBS: average price of an existing owner-occupied home in the Netherlands in 2025, published February 2026.

buy.name: A weekend in a European capital
buy.source: Eurostat, tourism expenditure 2024: EU residents spent on average EUR 224 per night on short trips abroad (1 to 3 nights), transport and accommodation included. Two nights.

buy.name: A month travelling Southeast Asia
buy.source: 1 month at the average living cost with rent of Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json), living like a local; the flight is not included.

buy.name: A trip to Japan
buy.source: Japan Tourism Agency, Consumption Trends of International Visitors 2025 (annual, final, 31 March 2026): a visitor from Germany spent JPY 392,251 in Japan, the flight not included; at the ECB's 2025 average of JPY 169.04 per euro.

ES.source: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
ES.note: Average public price per credit in a degree, 2024-2025: EUR 15.37 × 60 credits.

DE.note: Public universities charge EU students no tuition; the semester fee (about EUR 100-400) is not included.
